scripts.build: npm run build -w @social-cleanup/shared && npm run build -w @social-cleanup/web && npm run build -w @social-cleanup/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @social-cleanup/web" "npm run dev -w @social-cleanup/server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @social-cleanup/shared && npm run typecheck -w @social-cleanup/web && npm run typecheck -w @social-cleanup/server
